WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
),
filtered_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.equipref,
    ea.avg_humidity,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > oa.overall_avg
),
kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as kept_avg
  FROM filtered_equipment
)
SELECT 
  fe.equipref,
  fe.avg_humidity,
  fe.avg_humidity - fe.overall_avg as exceeds_overall,
  fe.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg as distance_from_kept_mean
FROM filtered_equipment fe
CROSS JOIN kept_average ka
ORDER BY 
  (fe.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg) IS NULL ASC,
  fe.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
